Annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase, and after that they can't be refunded. Lumen doesn't have a 60-day window, so the other agent's information was incorrect. At 20 days, your annual Pro purchase is outside the 14-day window, so it isn't eligible for a refund under the current policy.

You can still cancel at any time. You'd keep access until the end of the billing period you've already paid for. If you think your situation needs a closer look, email billing@lumen.io with your account email and purchase date, and the billing team can review your specific case.
